thread:
Ava (Product Designer): heads-up — found a confusing edge in the routing policies editor when using the scratchpad + preview together. quick thread with screenshots soon.
Miguel (PM): ok, what's the behaviour?
Ava (Product Designer): steps: 1) open a policy, 2) open scratchpad (temporary edits), 3) reorder rules in the scratchpad, 4) hit Preview. The preview simulation uses the pre-edit ordering and the left legend still shows the old counts. users think their reorder didn't save.
Sam (Frontend): can you repro locally? sounds like state isn't flushed to the sim.store before sim runs.
Ava (Product Designer): repro on latest staging. attaching small screen recording. The UI shows a subtle "Unsaved" dot on the tab but it's easy to miss.
Jordan (Accessibility): that dot isn't announced to screen readers and keyboard-only users can't focus to see the unsaved state. also color-only indicator.
Deepti (Eng-ML): simulation backend expects a committed rule snapshot; we deliberately hit a read-only sim endpoint. Could update sim call to accept ephemeral snapshots but need to debate perf.
Miguel (PM): two questions: a) immediate UX fix we can ship quickly? b) longer-term: support sim-ing ephemeral scratchpad state.
Ava (Product Designer): proposal A (fast): change Preview button state to "Preview (apply draft)" and when there are unsaved changes, show a persistent banner "Previewing draft — changes not applied to policy until you Save" and update legend counts to reflect draft. Also change unsaved indicator to "Draft" pill with role=status so SRs announce it.
Ava (Product Designer): proposal B (longer): enable preview to accept draft payloads (POST /policies/:id/simulate with ?snapshot=draft). this keeps performance but requires frontend + API change.
Sam (Frontend): for A we can fake legend counts client-side by running the same snapshot normalization used before sending to sim. minimal risk. I can spike PR today.
Deepti (Eng-ML): B is fine but we should guard: large policies could blow up sim memory if we send many snapshots concurrently. We could add a size cap and fallback to server-side diff.
Jordan (Accessibility): copy suggestions for the banner and pill: Banner: "You are previewing unsaved edits. Save to make them live." Pill: "Draft (unsaved) — press S to save". Make sure pill has aria-live=polite.
Miguel (PM): nice. Also UX microcopy for validation: currently we show a red badge that says "Invalid" on rules but no detail. Can we inline the reason in the panel?
Ava (Product Designer): yes — example change: current: "Invalid" -> proposed: "Missing match value — add a header or path to enable this rule". We should avoid ambiguous labels like "Error 3".
Sam (Frontend): agree. I'll add an expandable list of validation hints per rule. Likely small DOM change.
Deepti (Eng-ML): validation rules that run only on save vs preview differ right now. We need to converge so preview warns the same way save would. Otherwise users get validation surprise on save.
Miguel (PM): action items: Sam spike legend counts + pill and banner (A). Deepti to spec server limits if we want B later. Jordan to produce accessibility acceptance criteria for the pill and banner. Ava to write copy variations for banner + validation messages.
Ava (Product Designer): copy drafts: 
- Banner short: "Previewing unsaved edits — changes shown here are not saved."
- Banner CTA: "Save changes" (primary) and "Discard" (secondary).
- Validation example: "Missing match value — provide a value for this condition to enable the rule."
- Unsaved pill tooltip: "You have unsaved changes. Press Command/Ctrl+S to save."
Jordan (Accessibility): tweak: use "You have unsaved changes in this policy" for more context. Ensure tooltip is reachable via keyboard and tooltip text isn't the only place users learn the shortcut.
Sam (Frontend): small keyboard nits: we have existing S shortcut conflicting in nested editors. I'll check namespace collisions. Might use shift+S when focus is inside rule editor.
Miguel (PM): timeline: can we ship the fast fix this sprint?
Sam (Frontend): yes, spike today, PR tomorrow, aiming for merge by Thu.
Deepti (Eng-ML): I'll draft a short doc on snapshot sizing limits for B.
Ava (Product Designer): thanks all — I'll add a short mock for the pill/banner and the validation inline copies in Figma and drop the link here.
ui-ci-bot: build queued for branch feat/scratchpad-preview (job #4821).
Sam (Frontend): noted, will update the PR with the small a11y attributes Jordan requested.
Miguel (PM): great sync. if anyone finds other sim/scratchpad mismatches, reply to this thread so we can roll into the same fix.
